Korean Barbecue Beef
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, December 21, 2009 - 11:16pm

Ingredients




1/2 cup soy sauce
6 tablespoons sugar
4 tablespoons sesame oil
1/2 teaspoon pepper
6 Green onions, finely chopped
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 tablespoon sesame seeds
2 pounds tenderloin tips
4 tablespoons peanut oil
Combine first seven ingredients.

Preparation

1 Pour into a shallow, flat pan and place tenderloin tips in marinade. 2 Cover and let stand for 2 - 3 hours, turning occasionally. 3 Remove tips and stir fry quickly in hot peanut oil in wok. 4 Serve on a bed of rice.
